name: Klaviyo
description: Marketing automation platform specializing in email and SMS marketing, offering APIs to manage profiles, lists, campaigns, and events.

evidence.claim: Klaviyo provides three methods of authentication including private key authentication, OAuth, and public key authentication.
Klaviyo provides SDKs offered in Python, PHP, Ruby, and Node.
Klaviyo offers an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for AI agents.

notes: Klaviyo provides comprehensive developer tools including official SDKs (Python, PHP, Ruby, Node), OpenAPI specs, Postman collections, and an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.
